test_title: PYST 43: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 23 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: In what time (in years) will ₹2,500 fetch an interest of ₹1,000 at 10% per year simple interest?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹2,500

Simple Interest (SI) = ₹1,000

Rate of Interest (R) = 10% per year

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest formula: SI = (P × R × T) / 100

We need to find Time (T).

Rearranging the formula:

T = (SI × 100) / (P × R)

**Calculation:**

Substituting the values:

SI = 1,000, P = 2,500, R = 10

⇒ T = (1,000 × 100) / (2,500 × 10)

⇒ T = 100,000 / 25,000

⇒ T = 4 years

**The time required is 4 years.**
